* GitHub repository https://github.com/DexHunterIO/DH-Leverage
* Adjusted Deadlines at https://github.com/DexHunterIO/DH-Leverage/blob/main/README.md
* Added Parsing and Lending/ Borrowing core using 2 protocols on the cardano Blockchain (Liqwid/Surf)
* Added https://github.com/DexHunterIO/DH-Leverage/blob/main/development-process.md showing the development process and logic

In the system there is Persistence setup using redis and MongoDB, yet if the api is run without MongoDB or Redis connection it will start in No persistence mode, allowing to use the various protocols without needing to run mongo and redis.

Communicated catalyst deadline extension with support team

ms.report:
Milestone 3 Submission text: All the relevant code for leverage integration is at https://github.com/DexHunterIO/DH-Leverage at the a599252
 hash.

To run: Populate .env following sample.env Start mongodb if needed also using the bash script, and populate the .env.
Then Start the services using .quick-start.sh.

When all services have been started. Browse to http://localhost:8080/#/leverage to create leverage ( long short orders) using Recursive lends and borrows. ( max 1.8x Leverage). 
Else to the http://localhost:8080/#/perps to leverage trade using Perpetuals.

This frontend is the testing frontend which was extended to include leverage and leverage using perps. 
The final clean and polished frontend is for milestone 4.

All the flows have been tested manually: Short long on SNEK up to 1.8x recursive. Also Short long using perps on ADA up to 20x.
